LP-18 MASTER BRAIN v6 — 25Q MULTIMODAL COMMUNICATION ASSESSMENT

25Q governed evidence: Q1–15 Speaking + Audio • Q16–25 Writing. Audio is captured as evidence, not as capability truth. Five diagnostic layers: Locate → Bound → Resolve → Perturb → Confirm. The learner does not choose a CEFR level. The brain starts broad, narrows A1.1–C2.3, then increases/decreases difficulty and changes interaction conditions. It may stop early once evidence coverage and confidence are sufficient.
